dialogues.speaker: Struwell
dialogues.text: Shh... Listen up. The plan for tonight is...

dialogues.speaker: Moricztill
dialogues.text: Wait, we're doing it here? Where is this place, even...?

dialogues.speaker: Struwell
dialogues.text: Hehe, you didn't know, did you? This is the haunted house everyone in Millhaven talks about.

dialogues.speaker: Struwell
dialogues.text: They say a poor girl named Aisha slipped and fell off the cliff here. After that, she was never able to leave.

dialogues.speaker: Struwell
dialogues.text: Once night falls, people hear her crying around the haunted house.

dialogues.speaker: Struwell
dialogues.text: We're going to explore this haunted house tonight and find out, once and for all, if little Aisha's story is real!

dialogues.speaker: Max
dialogues.text: How do we explore it? Do we sneak in? Like how we snuck into Granny Marthe's house last time?

dialogues.speaker: Struwell
dialogues.text: Argh! Max, drop the failed prank thing already, would you!?

dialogues.speaker: Struwell
dialogues.text: If you hadn't gone bumbling around and knocked over her honey jar, we would've pulled it off for sure. We were so close to smearing the cream on her face!

dialogues.speaker: Struwell
dialogues.text: This time, we need a plan. A proper plan!

dialogues.speaker: Struwell
dialogues.text: Everybody, listen up! This time, we sneak in through the back window, then check the place room by room, back to front. Easy, right? Moricztill, you're on lookout duty.

dialogues.speaker: Moricztill
dialogues.text: Huh? That's alright, I guess. But if I get sleepy, can I just lie down outside for a bit? Take a nap?

dialogues.speaker: Struwell
dialogues.text: Oh, for goodness' sake! Do you even know the first thing about standing guard!?
